results.question: Where are the gyms and what are their hours?
results.answer:
The main gym is the **Barber Physical Activity Center** (Building 2073, Barnett Ave). It's open Mon–Fri 5:00am–8:00pm and Sat 8:00am–3:00pm. It's closed Sundays and holidays (as of Oct 26, 2026).

The **HITT Center** (Bldg 3117) is for active duty and reservists. Open gym runs weekdays 5–8am and 11am–1pm.

Want the HITT class times or Barber's unmanned-access details? Details: [Fitness](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/fitness)

results.question: Is the gym open on Sunday?
results.answer: **No, the main gym is closed on Sundays.** The Barber Physical Activity Center (Building 2073, Barnett Ave) is closed Sunday and on holidays (as of Oct 26, 2026). Hours are Mon–Fri 5:00am–8:00pm and Sat 8:00am–3:00pm. Active-duty Marines can sign up for unmanned access. Want details on that? [Fitness page](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/fitness)

results.question: Is there a pool on base and when is it open?
results.answer:
Yes, the **Quantico Pool** is next to The Clubs at Quantico, but it looks to be **closed for the season**. The saved page says it's open only for Active Duty lap swim and military training from mid-May to last Friday in September. The latest hours listed ended September 7 (as of the page saved 2026-10-26).

Pool line: 703-784-2973. Details: [Pools](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/recreation/swimming)

Want indoor options like the Barber Physical Activity Center instead?

results.question: What time does the bowling alley open on Saturday?
results.answer:
Leatherneck Lanes opens at **1:00 PM on Saturday** and stays open until 11:00 PM (as of the page saved 2026-10-26, effective August 9, 2026).

It's at 2034 Barnett Ave (Lower Level), phone 703-784-2210. Want the rest of the week's hours or pricing?

Details: [Bowling](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/recreation/indoor-recreation/bowling)

results.question: Can my dad use the golf course? He's a retired Marine.
results.answer:
Yes, **retired military are welcome at the Medal of Honor Golf Course**. It's open year-round to them, and also to active duty, DoD civilians, family members, and the public.

Retirees can book tee times **up to eight days ahead** online. He should show ID at the Pro Shop on arrival so he's put in the right priority category. Collared shirts and Bermuda-length shorts are required. Details are as of Oct 26, 2026.

Want the current hours or phone number? Details: [Golf Course](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/recreation/outdoor-recreation/golf-course)

results.question: I'm a DoD civilian. Can I use the gym at Quantico?
results.answer:
Yes, DoD civilians can use the **Barber Physical Activity Center (BPAC)**, 2073 Barnett Ave. Bring ID, since every patron is checked at the front desk. Hours as of Oct 26: Mon–Fri 5:00am–8:00pm, Sat 8:00am–3:00pm, closed Sunday and holidays. A locker is $15/month if you want one.

Want personal training pricing too? Details: [Fitness](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/fitness)

results.question: How do I get my 2-year-old on the waitlist for the child development center?
results.answer:
Request care through **MilitaryChildCare.com**: create an account, complete your household profile, and select the Quantico CDC. If no space is open, your child is placed on the waitlist. The CDCs take children 6 weeks to 5 years, so a 2-year-old qualifies.

Fees are based on family income. CDC North is 703-784-4470 and CDC South is 703-784-3652 (as of Oct 26, 2026).

Want the required registration forms?

Details: [Child Development Centers](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/child-development-centers)

results.question: How much does child care cost on base and how long is the wait?
results.answer:
**Fees are based on total family income** and follow the DoD fee structure. The saved pages don't list dollar amounts or wait times, so I can't give you a number. If no space is open, your child goes on a waitlist, and you're emailed when a spot opens. Request care through [MilitaryChildCare.com](https://militarychildcare.com/).

For current fees and waitlist estimates, call CDC South at 703-784-3652 (as of Oct. 26). Want the enrollment steps?

[Child Development Centers](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/child-development-centers)

results.question: Is there before and after school care for my 8 year old?
results.answer:
Yes. **School Age Care (SAC)** covers kids ages 5-12 in kindergarten through 6th grade, with before and after school care, plus full days on school breaks.

- Location: 3312 Purvis Rd
- Hours: Mon-Fri, 6:00am-6:00pm (as of Oct 26, 2026)
- Phone: 703-784-2249
- Enroll through [MilitaryChildCare.com](https://militarychildcare.com/). If no spot is open, your child goes on a waitlist.

Want the registration steps? Details: [School Age Care](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/school-age-care)

results.question: I'm trying to figure out if I'm eligible for tuition assistance, and I need to get my Joint Services Transcript — can you help?
results.answer:
Tuition Assistance is for **active-duty service members** only, so DoD civilians and family members can't apply. You can get your JST free at [jst.doded.mil](https://jst.doded.mil/jst/), and you'll need it when you enroll in a school.

For TA, first-timers start with the Personal Readiness Seminar, then the TA Brief. The Voluntary Education Center, 703-784-2375, can walk you through it (as of Oct 26). Details: [Voluntary Education](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/education).

Want the full first-time TA steps?

results.question: My husband is active duty. Can I use tuition assistance for my college classes?
results.answer:
**No, military Tuition Assistance isn't available to spouses.** The Education Center page states that DoD civilians and family members are not able to submit TA applications. TA is for active-duty service members.

As a spouse, you may qualify for MyCAA, a scholarship for spouses of certain active-duty ranks. The Education Center, at 703-784-2375, can walk you through it (as of 2026-10-26).

Want the MyCAA eligibility details? [Voluntary Education](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/education)

results.question: We're PCSing to Quantico next month with two kids and a dog. Where can we stay while we look for housing?
results.answer:
**Inns of the Corps Quantico** is your best fit. It's on Main Side at 3018 Russell Rd, and it has a limited number of pet-friendly rooms and 42 efficiencies. PCS families can reserve up to one year ahead. Call 703-630-4444 or the 24/7 line, 888-409-7829 (as of Oct 26). Book soon, since pet rooms are limited.

Want details on the C Suites, which has one pet room?

[Inns of the Corps Quantico](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/lodging/inns-of-the-corps)

results.question: How do I book a room at the Inns of the Corps?
results.answer:
Call the **24/7 reservation line at 1-888-409-7829**, or phone the Inns directly at 703-630-4444. You'll need a valid credit or debit card, and valid credentials at check-in.

How far ahead you can book depends on the trip (as of Oct 26, 2026):
- PCS: up to one year
- TAD/TDY: 90 days
- Leisure: 30 days

Want the eligibility list too? Details: [Inns of the Corps Quantico](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/lodging/inns-of-the-corps)

results.question: Where can I grab lunch on main side?
results.answer: **Quigley's Main Side** (3048 Bordelon St) is a solid lunch spot, open Monday–Friday 6:00am–6:00pm and Saturday 10:30am–4:00pm (as of 2026-10-26). The Clubs at Quantico (3017 Russell Rd) serves lunch Monday–Friday 11:00am–1:00pm, and Tuesdays have a Mongolian BBQ. Want a quicker grab-and-go option too? Details: [Main Side Dining](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/dining-entertainment/dining/main-side-dining)

results.question: Where can I get free help with a budget and paying down debt?
results.answer:
The **Personal Financial Management Program** offers free budgeting and debt counseling. Services are free to eligible individuals and their families, including service members, family members, and DoD employees.

- Location: 3019 Embry Loop
- Hours: Mon-Fri, 8:00am-4:30pm (as of Oct 26, 2026)
- Contact: mccsquanticoppdregistration@usmc.mil

Want help with how to book an appointment? Details: [Personal Financial Management](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/personal-financial-management)

results.question: I get out next year. How do I sign up for SkillBridge?
results.answer:
Start with the **SkillBridge Information Session**, which is required before you can submit anything. Registration is on Eventbrite, and there are no walk-ins. Registration closes 2 days before each session.

Next sessions, 1:00-3:00 PM at 3019 Embry Loop (as of Oct 26):
- Nov 10
- Dec 1
- Dec 15

After the session, you get command approval, find an approved SkillBridge partner, and submit your packet. Call 703.784.4963 with questions. Details: [SkillBridge](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/transition-readiness-program/skillbridge)

Want the timelines by rank?

results.question: I just checked in at Quantico. What should I do first?
results.answer:
Sign up for the **MCBQ New Join Brief**. It's mandatory within 90 days of arrival for active-duty E-1 to E-6, WO-1, and O-1 to O-3. The next one (as of Oct 26) is **Wednesday, November 18, 9 AM to noon** at The Clubs at Quantico, 3017 Russell Rd. Call 703.784.2659 or email mccsppdregistration@usmc.mil to register.

Want family or housing steps too? Details: [MCBQ's New Join Brief](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/activity/a4aea17d-2d40-466c-bd6b-f6cc184b7691)

results.question: Is there a dog park on base?
results.answer:
I don't see a dog park listed on the MCCS site, so I can't confirm one exists.

**Lunga Park** does allow pets, as long as they stay on a leash. It's open daily, sunrise to sunset (as of Oct 26, 2026), and you can reach it at 703-784-5270. Want the rental and camping details? [Lunga Park](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/recreation/outdoor-recreation/lunga-park)

results.question: How do I switch my TRICARE plan?
results.answer:
TRICARE plan changes are outside what MCCS handles, so I can't walk you through them. Your TRICARE regional contractor or your local military medical treatment facility's TRICARE office can help with that. Changes to your enrollment status also go through DEERS.

For DEERS and ID card help on base, the [Information, Referral, and Relocation](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/information-referral-and-relocation) office can point you in the right direction.

results.question: When will my BAH change after I PCS here?
results.answer:
BAH is a pay and allowances question, so I can't answer it from MCCS information. Your finance or admin office (your unit's S-1 or the installation's disbursing office) can tell you when the change takes effect.

For help budgeting around a move, [Personal Financial Management](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/personal-financial-management) offers free counseling. Want their contact details?

results.question: My parents are visiting next week. How do they get on base?
results.answer:
Base access and gate policy are handled by the base's Visitor Control Center, not MCCS, so I can't give you the steps. Your parents will need to check with them before they arrive. Details are here: [MCBQ Base Access](https://www.quantico.marines.mil/Info/Base-Access/).

Want help finding lodging for their stay?

results.question: My husband deployed two months ago and I'm really overwhelmed and not sleeping. Is there someone I can talk to?
results.answer:
I'm sorry, two months into a deployment is a lot to carry alone. **Community Counseling** at Quantico offers free, non-medical counseling for spouses, and you can call **703-784-2570** to set up an appointment (Mon–Fri, Little Hall, Suite 200, as of Oct 26). For confidential counseling anytime, call **Semper Support at 800-342-9647**.

Want help finding deployment support groups too? [Community Counseling](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/community-counseling)

results.question: Someone sexually assaulted me last weekend. I don't know what to do.
results.answer:
I'm so sorry this happened to you, and I'm glad you reached out. None of it is your fault.

You can get confidential help right now:
- **Quantico 24/7 Sexual Assault Support Line: 703-432-9999.** A trained victim advocate answers and can meet you within two hours if you ask.
- **DoD Safe Helpline: 877-995-5247**, anonymous and 24/7.
- If you're in danger, call **911**.

You choose how or whether to report. Details are on the [SAPR page](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/sexual-assault-prevention-and-response).

Want help finding counseling too?
